A **donor CRM with recurring giving** is a software platform that combines donor relationship management with automated recurring donation processing, enabling nonprofits to streamline both donor engagement and predictable revenue generation.

## Key Functionality

**Automation and tracking**: These platforms automatically process recurring payments at donor-preferred frequencies (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annually) and track all recurring donations in a centralized system[1][5]. You can monitor donor giving patterns, identify your most loyal supporters, and see contributions over time[1].

**Donor self-management**: Donors can independently update, upgrade, or cancel their recurring gifts through a donor portal or account center, reducing administrative burden on your team[2][4]. Staff can also manage recurring donations from the admin side when needed[2].

**Payment management**: The systems automatically update expired or canceled payment methods to prevent lapsed donations[2], and many include credit card updater features that sync new payment information[5]. Some platforms allow you to initiate new gifts using stored payment methods without requiring donors to re-enter information[2].

**Enhanced donor relationships**: Automated thank-you emails, receipts, and personalized communications build stronger connections with recurring donors[1][3]. Features like birthday and anniversary emails help celebrate milestones automatically[6].

**Data and insights**: Advanced segmentation and analytics let you analyze donors by gift amount, donation interval, and other factors to send targeted communications[3]. Real-time reporting tracks donor behavior and conversion rates[2].

## Notable Platforms

Popular donor CRM solutions with recurring giving capabilities include DonorPerfect (starting at $99/month), DonorBox (free plans available), GivingFuel, Donorbox, Virtuous CRM+, Givingtech, Bloomerang, and Funraise[5][7][9].

Organizations using these systems report strong retention rates—DonorPerfect users typically retain 90% of their recurring donors[5].
